proposal.description: Let the server inherit its client's priority (create its channel without _NTO_CHF_FIXED_PRIORITY)
proposal.diff:
--- a/rtdemo.c
+++ b/rtdemo.c
@@ -77,7 +77,7 @@
 /* _NTO_CHF_FIXED_PRIORITY: a server thread receiving on this channel keeps
  * its own priority instead of taking the client's. Creating the channel
  * without it (0) is the fix. */
-#define SERVER_CHANNEL_FLAGS _NTO_CHF_FIXED_PRIORITY
+#define SERVER_CHANNEL_FLAGS 0
 
 /* ---- Fixed workload ------------------------------------------------------- */
 #define A_PRIO        30
